# learned


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

Dhrona is the optional package (the `dhrona` extra) that learns from
past sessions. The learned folder is `<cfg>/learned`, a git repository.
Dhrona’s nightly batch never changes the files that Ramabana briefs
from. It commits each candidate it keeps on its own `pending/<id>`
branch of that repository. The briefing and skill discovery read only
the folder’s files, which are its HEAD. A pending candidate therefore
has no effect until a person accepts it. `--no-learned` leaves out the
folder whatever it holds.

[`pending`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#pending)
lists what waits,
[`diff`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#diff) shows
one candidate’s change,
[`accept`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#accept)
moves it onto HEAD, and
[`reject`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#reject)
drops it. Each of
[`diff`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#diff),
[`accept`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#accept)
and
[`reject`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#reject)
returns a dict with `ok` and `id`, and with `error` when `ok` is False.
A client application can display the returned dict directly.
[`accept`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#accept)
and
[`reject`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#reject)
take the lock that a Dhrona batch holds, and refuse while a batch runs.
[`diff`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#diff) takes
no lock.
[`accept`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#accept)
refuses only when the learned folder has an uncommitted change to a file
that the candidate also changes. A hand edit to another file stays as it
is, unstaged. Dhrona keeps each lesson as an entry in a dated file,
`dhrona-<date>.md`. Two lessons on the same day give two candidates that
change the same file, and the newer one holds both entries.
[`pending`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#pending)
lists only the newest, with the older ids in `includes`.
[`accept`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#accept)
on the newest deletes the older candidates.
[`reject`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#reject)
on the newest lists the older ones again.
[`accept`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#accept)
refuses a candidate that would take `AGENTS.md` past `LEARNED_MAX`.
`LEARNED_MAX` is the 2,000 characters that Dhrona allows one candidate.
Accepted rounds add up.
[`accept`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#accept)
keeps HEAD within the limit too.

[`compact`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#compact)
asks Dhrona for a shorter `AGENTS.md` when accepted lessons crowd it.
Dhrona’s editor model merges and shortens the paragraphs that Dhrona
proposed. It keeps every paragraph that a person wrote byte for byte. It
commits the result as one more pending candidate.
[`diff`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#diff),
[`accept`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#accept)
and
[`reject`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#reject)
act on that candidate like any other.

`compact(folder, id)` also folds in pending candidate `id`. This is the
case that
[`accept`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#accept)
refuses for size. The refusal returns `length` and names
`/learned compact ID`. Accepting that compaction accepts the candidate
with it.

[`compact`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#compact)
returns `{ok, id, before, after}`, where `before` and `after` are the
file’s length in characters. On failure it returns `{ok: False, error}`.
It needs the `dhrona` extra and says so when Dhrona is missing. It runs
one model turn and takes as long as that turn.

``` python
# git gets end of input, and a line waiting on the session's terminal stays there
import os, pty, subprocess, sys
m, s = pty.openpty(); os.write(m, b'x\n')
probe = "import os, select, tempfile; from ramabana.learned import _git; print(_git(tempfile.gettempdir(), 'hash-object', '--stdin').stdout.strip(), os.read(0, 9) if select.select([0], [], [], 1)[0] else b'')"
got = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', probe], stdin=s, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60).stdout.split()
os.close(s); os.close(m)
test_eq(got, ['e69de29bb2d1d6434b8b29ae775ad8c2e48c5391', "b'x\\n'"])
```

[`accept`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#accept)
first applies a candidate in a throwaway git worktree. A conflict never
leaves markers in the files that a running session briefs from. HEAD
moves only when the pick is clean. After HEAD moves,
[`restack`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#restack)
moves every other candidate proposed on an older HEAD onto the new HEAD
where it picks cleanly.
[`accept`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#accept)
returns those ids as `moved`. A candidate that no longer picks cleanly
is listed as `stale`. An example is a candidate that edits a line that a
compaction rewrote.
[`accept`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#accept)
returns those ids as `stale`, and
[`pending`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#pending)
gives the reason in each candidate’s `stale` field. A host can show the
reason beside the candidate. Ids sort by when Dhrona proposed them, and
moving a candidate does not change its id. A candidate whose change HEAD
already holds is accepted with `commit` set to `None`. The commit keeps
Dhrona as its author. Its commit time is the moment of acceptance, and
Dhrona’s 30-day expiry clock starts there.

``` python
import os, json, time
def git(d, *a): return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(d), *a], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
def propose(folder, files, id):
    "What Dhrona's `keep` does: a commit on `pending/<id>` off HEAD, the folder's files untouched."
    wt = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())/'wt'
    git(folder, 'worktree', 'add', '-q', '-b', PENDING + id, str(wt), 'HEAD')
    for rel, text in files.items(): (wt/rel).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); (wt/rel).write_text(text)
    git(wt, 'add', '-A'); git(wt, '-c', 'user.name=Dhrona', '-c', 'user.email=d@x', 'commit', '-qm', f'Lesson from a replay: {id}')
    git(folder, 'worktree', 'remove', '--force', str(wt))

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    f = Path(d)/'learned'; f.mkdir()
    (f/'AGENTS.md').write_text('A rule a person wrote.\n')
    git(f, 'init', '-q'); git(f, 'add', '-A'); git(f, '-c', 'user.name=t', '-c', 'user.email=t@x', 'commit', '-qm', 'first')
    a, b, c = '20261019-010101-aaaaaa', '20261019-020202-bbbbbb', '20261019-030303-cccccc'
    propose(f, {'skills/sizes/SKILL.md': '---\nname: sizes\ndescription: x\n---\nuse ls\n'}, a)
    propose(f, {'AGENTS.md': 'Something else entirely.\n'}, b)
    propose(f, {'AGENTS.md': 'A third view.\n'}, c)
    test_eq([(p['id'], p['files']) for p in pending(f)], [(a, ['skills/sizes/SKILL.md']), (b, ['AGENTS.md']), (c, ['AGENTS.md'])])
    test_eq((f/'AGENTS.md').read_text(), 'A rule a person wrote.\n')
    assert not (f/'skills').exists()
    assert '+use ls' in diff(f, a)['diff']
    r = accept(f, a)
    test_eq(r['moved'], [b, c])
    assert r['ok'] and r['commit'] and (f/'skills'/'sizes'/'SKILL.md').exists() and a not in [p['id'] for p in pending(f)]
    test_eq(git(f, 'log', '-1', '--format=%an'), 'Dhrona')
    test_eq(accept(f, b)['ok'], True)
    test_eq([p['stale'] for p in pending(f)], [STALE])     # `c` rewrites the line `b` changed
    head, text = git(f, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), (f/'AGENTS.md').read_text()
    r = accept(f, c)
    assert not r['ok'], r
    test_eq((git(f, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), (f/'AGENTS.md').read_text()), (head, text))
    assert '<<<<' not in text and git(f, 'status', '--porcelain') == ''
    test_eq(reject(f, c), dict(ok=True, id=c))
    test_eq(pending(f), [])
    test_eq(accept(f, c)['ok'], False)
    test_eq(accept(f, '--force')['ok'], False)             # not an id, never an option
    propose(f, {'AGENTS.md': 'Hand edit pending.\n'}, a)
    (f/'AGENTS.md').write_text('an uncommitted edit\n')
    test_eq(accept(f, a)['ok'], False)                      # a hand edit blocks it
    git(f, 'checkout', '-q', '--', '.')
    with _locked(f) as held:                                # a batch holds it
        assert held and not accept(f, a)['ok'] and not reject(f, a)['ok']
    test_eq(len(git(f, 'worktree', 'list').splitlines()), 1)
    test_eq(pending(Path(d)/'none'), [])
    git(f, 'checkout', '-q', '--', '.'); reject(f, a)
    propose(f, {'AGENTS.md': 'A rule a person wrote.\n' + 'x' * LEARNED_MAX}, a)   # past Dhrona's limit
    head, r = git(f, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), accept(f, a)
    assert not r['ok'] and r['length'] > LEARNED_MAX and git(f, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == head, r
    assert a in learned_command(f)
    test_eq(learned_command(f, f'reject {a}'), f'rejected {a}')
    test_eq(learned_command(f), 'nothing is pending')
```

``` python
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    f = Path(d)/'learned'; f.mkdir()
    (f/'AGENTS.md').write_text('A rule a person wrote.\n')
    git(f, 'init', '-q'); git(f, 'add', '-A'); git(f, '-c', 'user.name=t', '-c', 'user.email=t@x', 'commit', '-qm', 'first')
    a = '20261019-010101-aaaaaa'
    propose(f, {'AGENTS.md': 'A rule a person wrote.\n\n' + 'Read sizes with ls -l. ' * 40 + '\n'}, a); accept(f, a)
    r = compact(f, chat=lambda prompt: '[kept 1]\n\nRead sizes with ls -l.')
    assert r['ok'] and r['before'] > r['after'] and r['id'] in learned_command(f), r
    test_eq(git(f, 'show', f"{PENDING}{r['id']}:AGENTS.md"), 'A rule a person wrote.\n\nRead sizes with ls -l.')
    assert not compact(f)['ok']                            # the pending compaction stands in the way
    import sys; mod = sys.modules.pop('dhrona.improve'); sys.modules['dhrona.improve'] = None   # dhrona not installed
    try: assert not compact(f)['ok']
    finally: sys.modules['dhrona.improve'] = mod
```

``` python
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    f = Path(d)/'learned'; f.mkdir()
    (f/'AGENTS.md').write_text('A rule a person wrote.\n')
    git(f, 'init', '-q'); git(f, 'add', '-A'); git(f, '-c', 'user.name=t', '-c', 'user.email=t@x', 'commit', '-qm', 'first')
    a, big, x, y = '20261019-010101-aaaaaa', '20261019-020202-bbbbbb', '20261019-030303-cccccc', '20261019-040404-dddddd'
    lessons = 'A rule a person wrote.\n\n' + 'Read sizes with ls -l. ' * 40 + '\n'
    propose(f, {'AGENTS.md': lessons}, a); accept(f, a)
    propose(f, {'AGENTS.md': lessons + '\n' + 'Run pytest -q before a commit. ' * 40 + '\n'}, big)
    propose(f, {'skills/rg/SKILL.md': '---\nname: rg\ndescription: x\n---\nuse rg\n'}, x)
    propose(f, {'AGENTS.md': lessons.replace('Read sizes', 'Read file sizes', 1)}, y)
    r = accept(f, big)
    assert not r['ok'] and r['length'] > LEARNED_MAX, r
    r = compact(f, big, chat=lambda prompt: '[kept 1]\n\nRead sizes with ls -l.\n\nRun pytest -q before a commit.')
    assert r['ok'] and r['before'] > LEARNED_MAX >= r['after'], r
    assert not compact(f, '20990101-000000-abcdef')['ok']
    r = accept(f, r['id'])                                  # the compaction carries `big` with it
    assert r['ok'] and (f/'AGENTS.md').read_text() == 'A rule a person wrote.\n\nRead sizes with ls -l.\n\nRun pytest -q before a commit.\n', r
    test_eq((r['moved'], r['stale']), ([x], [y]))           # `x` moved onto the compacted file; `y` edits a line it rewrote
    test_eq([(p['id'], p['stale']) for p in pending(f)], [(x, None), (y, STALE)])
    assert f'{y}  AGENTS.md' in learned_command(f)
    test_eq(git(f, 'rev-parse', f'{PENDING}{x}^'), git(f, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'))
    assert accept(f, x)['ok'] and accept(f, y)['error'] == STALE
```

[`learned_command`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#learned_command)
is the text form a terminal shows. `/learned` in a session and
`ramabana-learned` from a shell both use it: with no argument it lists
what is pending, `diff ID`, `accept ID` and `reject ID` act on one, and
[`compact`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#compact)
proposes a shorter `AGENTS.md`.

Learning is one setting per machine: `learning` in config.toml (see
[setup](19_setup.ipynb)). It is on unless set off.
`set_enabled(cfg, False)`, `/learned off` in a session and
`ramabana-learned off` in a shell turn it off for every session on this
machine, whatever its config folder. When learning is off:

- The briefing leaves out the learned `AGENTS.md` and the learned
  skills.
- The briefing drops its rule to record lessons.
- `remember` keeps plain notes only.
- [`Agent.lessons()`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/agent.html#agent.lessons)
  returns none.
- The session writes no `start.json`.
- Dhrona’s nightly schedule returns “learning is off” and does not touch
  the learned folder.

Lessons already kept stay where they are, unread. The review queue still
works, and a person can clear it. `Agent(learned=False)` and the CLI’s
`--no-learned` turn learning off for one session only.

Ramabana 0.2.44 kept the switch in each config folder’s `settings.json`.
When config.toml does not set `learning`, `enabled(cfg)` reads the value
from `<cfg>/settings.json` and writes it into config.toml. A choice made
there survives. If the write fails,
[`enabled`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#enabled)
keeps answering from `settings.json`. Ramabana never writes the
`settings.json` that an embedding app shares. Ramabana never rewrites a
config.toml that is not valid TOML.
[`set_enabled`](https://vedicreader.github.io/ramabana/learned.html#set_enabled)
raises `ValueError` saying so, and `/learned on` returns that message:

``` python
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    os.environ['RAMABANA_CONFIG'] = str(toml := Path(d)/'config.toml')
    try:
        assert enabled(d)
        test_eq(learned_command(learned_folder(d), 'off'), 'learning is off')
        test_eq((enabled(d), (Path(d)/SETTINGS).exists()), (False, False))
        assert '\nlearning = false\n' in toml.read_text()
        test_eq(set_enabled(d, True), True)
        toml.unlink(); (Path(d)/SETTINGS).write_text(json.dumps({'editor': {'tabSize': 2}, 'learning': 'off'}))
        test_eq(enabled(d), False)
        assert 'learning = false' in toml.read_text() and json.loads((Path(d)/SETTINGS).read_text())['learning'] == 'off'
        toml.write_text('learning = [')
        learned_command(learned_folder(d), 'on')
        test_eq(toml.read_text(), 'learning = [')
    finally: os.environ.pop('RAMABANA_CONFIG')
```
